stem: Which graph represents y as a function of x?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph labeled F showing a curve opening left and right symmetric about the y-axis

options.label: H
options.text: Graph labeled H showing a curve looping horizontally crossing x values multiple times

options.label: G
options.text: Graph labeled G showing a curve opening right and left symmetric about the y-axis

options.label: J
options.text: Graph labeled J showing a wavy curve passing the vertical line test

visual_elements: Graph F: A curve symmetric about y-axis opening left and right, y labeled vertical, x labeled horizontal, axis scales from -9 to 9 on both axes
Graph H: A horizontal looping curve crossing some x-values multiple times, y vertical, x horizontal, axes from -9 to 9
Graph G: A curve symmetric about y-axis opening left and right, similar to F but flipped, axes same
Graph J: A wavy curve starting near bottom left, rising and falling multiple times, passing vertical line test, axes same
notes: Math function concept testing vertical line test via graph inspection.
